params.prompt:
Square 1:1 cinematic poster in the style of a premium AI-education brand, matching the attached reference image style (same typography, same warm black, same golden light). Photoreal 3D render on a warm near-black background (#0B0907), single golden rim light from behind, subtle haze and floating gold dust. Typography: bold geometric wide sans (Unbounded-like) for the headline and big numbers, white with marked phrases in electric yellow #FDD506; captions in a clean grotesque (Manrope-like) in white and light grey. Only two text colours: white/light grey and yellow #FDD506. No green anywhere.

Layout top to bottom:
(1) Two-line headline centred in the top 17% of the frame, bold white Unbounded-like:
line 1, white: "Если бы это навсегда закрыло"
line 2, white with the quoted phrase in yellow #FDD506: "вопрос «где брать клиентов»" — the words «где брать клиентов» including the guillemets are yellow, the word "вопрос" is white.
(2) Right under the headline, one horizontal formula row in large white characters with thin yellow multiplication and equals signs, the result part in yellow:
"4–12 сайтов в месяц × чек $250 = $1.000–$3.000 в месяц" — "4–12 сайтов в месяц" white, "×" yellow, "чек $250" white, "=" yellow, "$1.000–$3.000 в месяц" yellow.
(3) Middle ~40% of the frame: on a dark glossy desk a slim open laptop on the left; from its screen a fan of twelve thin translucent glass website panels flies to the right in a gentle rising arc, the first four panels bright, sharp and warmly lit, the next eight progressively dimmer and softer (visualising 'from 4 to 12 sites'); the panels show abstract dark website layouts with photo blocks and button shapes, NO readable text, no letters on them; at the end of the arc the panels land on a neat stack of matte gold coins glowing softly.
(4) Bottom ~33% of the frame, centred:
a small light-grey label: "Только на сайтах"
under it a huge bold yellow sum in the Unbounded-like font: "$1.000–$3.000"
then a white line: "Четыре сайта — это четыре сотни сообщений агента"
then a white line: "На старте это только сайты — одна услуга из семи."
then a final yellow line, bold: "Сколько бы это стоило?"

Exact Russian text in quotes, spelled exactly character by character, with en dashes "–" in the number ranges, em dashes "—" in the sentences, Russian guillemets «», dots as thousands separators ($1.000, $3.000). No other text anywhere in the image, no extra words, no labels on the laptop or panels, no logos, no watermark, no signature. Generous 7% margins on every side, nothing cropped, all text perfectly legible and sharp.
